## Triage: audit · p2 · `domain:server` · 2026-11-05T15:02Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- The server locale resolvers do not read `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES` / `platformLocaleTagOf`, so a `zh-TW` / `zh-HK` reader gets Simplified Chinese even where a `zh-Hant` bundle exists.
- p2 as suggested. It lands as each #30512 package adds `zh-Hant`. It is the server counterpart of #30511's console aliases. `pm:triage` → `pm:queue`.

domain:spec#3 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTqqeHSwZYJmApbDCa

Landed: PR #30601 merged at `af8aab1b`. The platform now has one locale-matching ladder, `resolveLocaleAmong` in `@objectstack/spec/system`. It runs: exact, case-insensitive, the platform locale table's language, base language, then first variant. `resolveBundleLocale`, core's `resolveLocale` and `resolveOfferedLocale` all answer through it. A `zh-TW` / `zh-HK` / `zh-MO` reader now gets a registered `zh-Hant` bundle instead of the first `zh-*` one, which is Simplified.

| Probe on `origin/main` after the merge | Reading |
| --- | --- |
| `git merge-base --is-ancestor af8aab1b origin/main` (tip `ca37605c5`) | ancestor |
| `resolveLocaleAmong` on `main` | defined and used in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (3 hits); `packages/core/src/fallbacks/memory-i18n.ts` :52 (`resolveLocale`) and :74 (`resolveOfferedLocale`) both `return resolveLocaleAmong(…)` |

The merge queue landed it at 2026-11-05T20:20:53Z, and `Fixes #30538` closed the card as completed. This seat removes `pm:dispatched` in the same stroke. Carried: #30603 (the Skills-docs rewrite), #30617, #30618 (script-subtag codes), #30619 (the exact fast path's prototype-name answer). S4 and the Console's `pickRenderableLocale` are on #30511.
